en: A black-and-white image depicting a European street scene in an old town, likely from the early 20th century. The street is lined with historic buildings featuring ornate facades and a turreted house. There are two prominent church spires visible in the background, suggesting the presence of a significant church. A horse-drawn carriage is seen on the cobblestone street, and a few pedestrians, including two children, are present. Signs on the buildings include German text such as 'Restaurant', 'Petri... & Kopsch', and 'Chocolade'.
